label: KODAK VISION3 50D 5203/7203
source: Kodak technical data H-1-5203 (March 2026 edition), curves traced from the PDF's raster figures (pages 3-4)

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal of exposure in erg/cm2 for density 0.2 above D-min); curves clipped at 0.0 by the source plot

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Eastman Kodak Company. Dye density plot header reads 'Process: ECN-2; D-mins subtracted'; minimum is the dashed Minimum Density curve as plotted. Sensitometric densities made non-decreasing (largest change 0.0024, red toe). Spectral sensitivity curves end where they meet the plot floor (0.0). Spectral sensitivity y axis: gridlines at plot rows 498/387/276/165 are 1.0/2.0/3.0/4.0 (labels sit just above their lines); values corrected by +1.0 from the first trace.

granularity.value: log10 diffuse RMS granularity (sigma D x 1, 48 um aperture)
granularity.note: Diffuse RMS granularity, same datasheet raster figure; x shifted so the plot's green density curve equals the sensitometric green density at 0 stops (1.442), i.e. log relative exposure 2.467 is 0. G and R granularity curves overlap below about log E 2.7 (plot units) and share the traced band centre there.

scan.note: fitted to 96 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871968331-kodak-vision3-50d/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
